tasks.answer: Use ConfirmationDialog (components/ui/dialog/confirmation-dialog/confirmation-dialog.tsx; the dialog barrel @/components/ui/dialog re-exports it). Required props: triggerButton (ReactElement shown via DialogTrigger asChild), confirmButton (ReactElement, the destructive action), title (string). Optional: body, cancelButtonText (default 'Cancel'), icon ('danger'|'info', default 'danger'), isDone (closes on true). DeleteDiscussion uses it with title="Delete Discussion", body="Are you sure you want to delete this discussion?", icon="danger".

Input (components/ui/form/input.tsx), a native <input> wrapped in FieldWrapper. It binds to react-hook-form by spreading the register result: <Input type="email" label="Email Address" error={formState.errors['email']} registration={register('email')} />; registration: Partial<UseFormRegisterReturn> is spread as {...registration} onto the <input>. label/error are optional pass-through props; the login form gets register/formState from <Form schema={loginInputSchema}> render prop.

Pagination is rendered by TablePagination (TablePaginationProps: totalPages, currentPage, rootUrl; links built as `${rootUrl}?page=${n}`). DiscussionsList uses it indirectly through <Table pagination={{ totalPages: meta.totalPages, currentPage: meta.page, rootUrl: '' }} />. Note: Table is exported from @/components/ui/table (barrel index.ts only re-exports ./table); TablePagination/TablePaginationProps are NOT re-exported by that barrel, only from ./pagination. Table itself requires data and columns.

MDPreview (components/ui/md-preview/md-preview.tsx) takes a single value: string prop and renders sanitized HTML: dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: DOMPurify.sanitize(parse(value)) }} using marked + dompurify. Used as <MDPreview value={discussion.body} /> in discussion-view.tsx (also comments-list).

CreateDiscussion takes no props. It is wrapped in <Authorization allowedRoles={[ROLES.ADMIN]}> so only ADMIN users see it (others render forbiddenFallback=null by default). It opens a FormDrawer ("Create Discussion") containing a Form with id "create-discussion" and schema createDiscussionInputSchema (title + body) that calls useCreateDiscussion.
